description: 工具元数据定义——每把工具的声明式描述：分类、可逆级别、参数 Schema。供 Toolkit.setToolMeta() 注入。

read_file.description: Read the contents of a file at the given path.

write_file.description: Write content to a file at the given path.

search_code.description: Search for code patterns in the project.

run_shell.description: Run a shell command and return its output.

list_files.description: List files and directories at the given path.

dir_path.description: Absolute path to directory (default: current workspace)

delete_file.description: Delete a file at the given path. Irreversible — use with caution.

file_path.description: Absolute path to file to delete

parse_ast.description: Parse a source file and return its AST (Abstract Syntax Tree).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file to parse

max_depth.description: Maximum AST depth to return (default: 6, max: 12)

include_text.description: Include source text snippets in AST nodes (default: true)

web_search.description: Search the web and return structured results.

search_symbol.description: Scan a TS/JS source file and return a structured symbol table (functions, classes, interfaces, enums, type aliases, exports) with names, positions, and signatures.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file to scan

kind_filter.description: Comma-separated kind filter: function, class, interface, enum, typeAlias, variable, export, all (default: all)

read_many_files.description: Read multiple files in parallel. Returns concatenated output with file headers. Use this instead of multiple read_file calls to reduce round-trips.

file_paths.description: Array of absolute file paths to read (max 10)

grep_files.description: Search for a pattern within a specific list of files. Unlike search_code (project-wide ripgrep), this searches only the exact files you specify.

pattern.description: Text or regex pattern to search for (case-insensitive)

file_paths.description: Array of absolute file paths to search within (max 20)

file_info.description: Get metadata for a file: size (bytes), line count, existence, file/directory type.

glob_find.description: Recursively find files matching a glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.test.ts', 'src/**/*.{js,ts}'). Supports **, *, ?, {a,b}.

dir_path.description: Root directory to search from (default: workspace root)

resolve_import.description: Resolve an import specifier to an absolute file path. Given a source file and its import statement (e.g. './foo', '@/utils/bar'), returns the resolved target file path.

source_file.description: Absolute path to the source file containing the import

format_code.description: Format code in a file or directory using prettier, eslint, or biome. Safer than running shell commands directly.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file or directory to format

check_only.description: If true, only check formatting without modifying files

json_query.description: Query a JSON file using JSONPath syntax (e.g. '$.store.books[*].title', '$.items[?(@.price<10)]'). Returns matched value(s).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the JSON file to query

edit_file.description: Perform precise search-and-replace in a file. Unlike write_file (full overwrite), only touches the matched text. Use replace_all=true to replace all occurrences.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to edit

old_text.description: The exact text to find and replace

run_test.description: Run tests with automatic framework detection (vitest, jest, playwright, mocha). Detects the framework from config files, or specify manually.

test_path.description: Optional: specific test file or glob pattern

args.description: Additional CLI args to pass to test runner

diff_files.description: Compare two files and return a unified diff. Pure in-memory LCS algorithm—no external diff dependency.

file_a.description: Absolute path to the first file (baseline)

file_b.description: Absolute path to the second file (changed)

context_lines.description: Number of context lines around each diff hunk (default: 3)
